resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Preflight refuses a commit whose subject is followed by a non-blank line
body: Outcome: npm run preflight (diff check over the PR commits) refuses a commit whose message line 2 is not empty, naming the commit, exit 65. Evidence: the t-g9ab2vk session wrote three commits with git commit -F heredocs that had no blank line after the subject, so subject, body and trailers merged into one paragraph (pre-rebase 0efbf8c, bc79924, de11a8e); the lead caught it by eye and rewrote them with rebase --exec. Proof: a test/rules observer with a fixture commit whose line 2 is non-empty is red at base by assertion and green at head.
